digest.component_or_area: CI test audit and performance optimization
propositions: Exhaustive CI audit identified 501 unique test phases >=1.0s across three recent successful Gerrit Verify runs and local census, with no individual phase exceeding 30s in macOS or Ubuntu cells.

Gerrit 1817 / 53efe2426e merged and removed 19 proven OS/Python-invariant repository-policy nodes from macOS and Ubuntu 3.11/3.12 while retaining them in Ubuntu 3.13, yielding ~8s macOS wall and 24.84 aggregate runner-seconds without new jobs.

External analyzers, Git concurrency, import/packaging benchmarks, and signing/identity gates constitute the majority of kept cost; real filesystem, process, and platform behavior cannot be mocked equivalently.

No new macOS/Ubuntu shard or additional job is recommended; prior investigation (coercive-paediatric-bug) proved routing increased job-minutes 18.6→21.0 and burst contention, eliminating the proposal.
